newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster Q4 net up on revenue gains.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster Q4 net up on revenue gains.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Thursday solid revenue gains at its operating divisions helped net income climb by 43 percent in the fourth quarter.

The company reported net income of $65 million in the period, up from $42 million in the fourth quarter a year ago. Revenues in the period totaled $874 million versus $788 million in the corresponding quarter last year.
ServiceMaster said its International and Consumer Services units posted double-digit revenue gains in the period.
ServiceMaster provides a variety of services to residential, commercial and industrial customers in the area of lawn care, pest control, security and maintenance.
Its shares were up 1/4 in late morning trade on Thursday at 26.
